description: Run one or more SQL statements against any registered resource exposing .get_connection() -- one component covering postgres/mysql/duckdb/databricks_sql/mssql/oracle/db2/doris/starburst/starrocks/timescaledb/trino instead of a dialect-specific asset per resource type.

resource_key.description: Key of a registered resource that exposes .get_connection() returning a DBAPI connection (directly, or via its own @contextmanager). Matches postgres_resource, mysql_resource, duckdb_resource, databricks_sql_resource, mssql_resource, oracle_resource, db2_resource, doris_resource, starburst_resource, starrocks_resource, timescaledb_resource, trino_resource. For Snowflake, use snowflake_sql_asset instead.
resource_key.label: Resource Key

sql.description: SQL text, run in a single cursor.execute() call. Whether multiple ;-separated statements run in one call is driver-dependent (works for psycopg2/duckdb; most other drivers run only the first). Set exactly one of sql / sql_file / sql_statements.
sql.label: Sql

sql_statements.label: Sql Statements
sql_statements.description: Explicit list of statements, each run as its own cursor.execute() call -- the one way to run multiple statements that works regardless of driver. Set exactly one of sql / sql_file / sql_statements.

sql_file.label: Sql File
sql_file.description: Path (relative to the Dagster process working directory) to a .sql file, read and treated the same as `sql`. Set exactly one of sql / sql_file / sql_statements.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.description: Bind parameters applied to every statement. Placeholder style is whatever the underlying driver's DBAPI paramstyle is (e.g. pyformat %(name)s for psycopg2/mysql-connector, qmark ? or named :name for pyodbc/oracledb) -- passed through as-is, not translated.

pre_sql.label: Pre Sql
pre_sql.description: Dialect-specific statements run before the main SQL, e.g. ['SET search_path TO analytics'] (Postgres) or ['USE mydb'] (MySQL) -- write whatever your dialect needs; this component doesn't guess it for you.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds
